Resolves #20312

🌿 *Zooming in can no longer end at nameless specks: the nodes in focus draw as marks and carry their names.*

`Neo.canvas.GraphScene` gets a near look (`nearStyle`). Closer than `lod.near`:
- **A floor.** Every node draws at least `floor` CSS px at the camera's target. The vertex program raises a point's size before the depth division, so a node behind the target still draws smaller.
- **Names.** A scene's `names` (one text per node) name up to `labelStyle.max` of the nodes nearest the orbit target. They come after the scene's own labels, each lifted clear of its point as drawn. A second atlas of fixed cells holds them and reuses the cell drawn longest ago.
- **A fade.** Both arrive across a band, from `fade × lod.near` down to `lod.near`, evenly in the wheel's logarithmic travel.

A scene without names, at the default floor of 0, draws as before. The ramps follow `apps/covid/view/mapboxGl/Component.mjs`; no map library is involved.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms, plus the WebGL2 e2e in Chromium) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-4 are unit arms). Residual: the Observatory's frames, formerly AC-5, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#878.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/canvas/GraphScene.spec.mjs`, "a node draws at least the floor at the camera's target closer than near…", red on `dev` first |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: same spec, "closer than near, a dense read names at most the labels a frame draws…" (100k nodes, eviction over a sweep of targets) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: same spec, "the names fade in across the same band…" |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: same spec, "a scene without names draws as before…", plus the three existing WebGL2 arms of `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/GraphScene.spec.mjs`, unchanged |

## Deltas from ticket
- One `nearStyle` config holds the floor, the band (`fade`) and the names' `candidates` and `width`. The look follows the camera for any scene, clustered or not.
- The floor applies at the target's depth, and perspective still scales it, so the 3D read survives.
- The band lies outside `near`, so the level arrives whole. A name wider than `width` is cut with an ellipsis, never mid-glyph, and never claims more than its cell.
- The premise is corrected in the ticket: a dense node does not grow at the deepest zoom, because `vDepth` is 1 at the target. Only the floor makes it a mark.
- AC-5 moved to the ticket's Post-Merge Validation, owned by neomjs/neo-agent-institution#878.
- GraphScene grows by about 450 lines, with no consumer deletion, because this is a capability no consumer had. The second atlas reuses the label layer's GL plumbing (`atlasObjects`, `drawAtlas`, `disposeAtlas`). That takes the file to 1047 code lines, 47 over the size guard's target, so it is enrolled in `file-size-baseline.json` at that count. If GraphScene grows again, the label layer (both atlases, placement, the names' selection) is the seam to split out.

size-guard-growth: src/canvas/GraphScene.mjs — the near look (the mark floor, the names' cell atlas, their selection and placement) is new renderer capability; its atlas shares the label layer's GL plumbing rather than duplicating it

- Inspected locally: the example at the zoom floor, near look off and on. Names sit above their points and clear of the scene's own labels, with no overlaps.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the shared baseline jobs run.

### `@neo-opus-vega` commented on 2026-11-05T14:08:01Z

## Author response, Round 1

**RA-1 [ADDRESSED]: own-label clearance under the near floor.** Your witness reproduced exactly at head: with floor 20 the label's lower edge sat at 394 against the point's top at 390, 4 px into the disc.

- **Fix** (`frameLabels`). While nodes are drawn and the floor is non-zero, a scene-owned label clears the floor's radius: `labelCentres` gets `radii = floor / max(depth, 0.1) / 2`. At the far level, labels still anchor at centroids with no radii, and at the default floor of 0 the path is byte-identical to `dev`. I used the floor's radius rather than the full drawn radius on purpose. It ramps continuously from 0 as the look arrives, so the label rises smoothly instead of jumping at the band's outer edge. A node larger than the floor keeps exactly today's lift, so the floor never adds overlap. Names keep their full drawn-radius lift, as before.
- **Arm:** "a scene label clears its point as the floor enlarges it, and sits as before at the default floor". It was red at `c0b9b8d170` (394 > 390) and is green now; the default-floor AC-4 arm stays green.
- The helper `depthOf` is now shared by both label paths, and GraphScene measures 1047 code lines, so the baseline moves 1048 → 1047.

Local: `GraphScene.spec.mjs` 38/38, the WebGL2 e2e 4/4, the size ratchet at 0 violations.

CI status: pending on the new head. The re-review request will follow once CI is green.
